risk_if_not_implemented: Without Information Assurance Enabled Products, executive management, the Board of Directors (BoD) and assessors may rely on inaccurate, incomplete or unverifiable control and risk information. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Regulatory / Legal / Contractual Financial Liability (R-EX-5), Loss of Authorization / Certification / License (R-EX-11), and most likely increases susceptibility to Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11), Cryptographic Compromise / Cryptanalytic Capability Advancement (MT-31).

compensating_control_1.name: Security, Compliance & Resilience Requirements Definition
compensating_control_1.description:
Mechanisms exist to proactively govern Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) by:
(1) Defining technical security, compliance and resilience requirements; and
(2) Performing a criticality analysis at predefined decision points in the Secure Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
compensating_control_1.justification: Security, Compliance & Resilience Requirements Definition (PRM-09) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Information Assurance Enabled Products (TDA-06.6) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Minimum Viable Product (MVP) Security Requirements
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to design, develop and produce Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) in such a way that risk-based technical and functional specifications ensure Minimum Viable Product (MVP) criteria establish an appropriate level of security and resiliency based on applicable risks and threats.
compensating_control_2.justification: Minimum Viable Product (MVP) Security Requirements (TDA-11.1) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Information Assurance Enabled Products (TDA-06.6) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
